name: UpdateDNSServiceRuleAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The destination type for the DNS authorization rule. Valid values:

Normal: a standard rule.

DNSRedirect: a redirection rule. This type redirects the current DNS service endpoint to another endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
DNS授权规则的目标类型。取值：

Normal：普通类型。

DNSRedirect：重定向类型，重定向类型指将当前DNS服务地址重定向至另一个地址
parameters.name: service_type

parameters.help_en:
The DNS service endpoint after redirection.

This parameter is required when ServiceType is set to DNSRedirect
parameters.help_zh:
重定向后的DNS服务地址。

当ServiceType参数取值为DNSRedirect时，该参数必选
parameters.name: destination

parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The name of the DNS authorization rule.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
DNS授权规则名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: dns_service_rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the DNS authorization rule.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
DNS授权规则描述。

长度为2~256个字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，但不能为`http://`或`https://`
parameters.name: dns_service_rule_description

parameters.help_en:
A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value from your client to ensure that the same request is not repeated. The client token supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: sends a check request without modifying the DNS authorization rule. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): sends a normal request. After the check passes, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the rule is modified
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改DNS授权规则。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行修改
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the DNS authorization rule.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
DNS授权规则所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
